item.title: San Angelo Central’s Boyd Garners 2 More Division I Offers
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The college offers continue to roll in for highly regarded San Angelo Central offensive lineman Ethan Boyd.In the last 10 days, Boyd has received three offers from NCAA Division I schools.The first came from Oklahoma State on Jan. 27. Since then, he’s also had offers from UTEP and Georgia State. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Central’s Edwards Commits to Angelo State
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — San Angelo Central wide receiver Jimmy Edwards has committed to play football for his hometown college, Angelo State University.Edwards made the announcement Friday, choosing ASU over offers from Sul Ross State, Texas Wesleyan, Howard Payne and Sterling. item.title: Tom Green County Clerk Sued Over Rear-End Crash
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A San Angelo woman is suing Tom Green County Clerk Christina Ubando and Isaias Jimenez for damages exceeding $100,000, alleging negligence in a February 2024 rear-end collision that caused severe injuries. Maria Lopez filed the lawsuit Jan. 7 in Tom Green County Court at Law, claiming Jimenez rear-ended the 2007 Hyundai Tucson in which she was a passenger as it slowed in the 800 block of Spaulding Street around 1:28 p.m. Feb. 27, 2024. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Water Bills: Online Credit/Debit Card Payments Temporarily Unavailable

item.title: Update: Fatal Shooting in San Angelo — Teen Victim Dead, 19-Year-Old in Custody
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — An 18-year-old was pronounced deceased after being shot Friday evening at the Windmill Apartments, and police have taken a 19-year-old male into custody, authorities stated. San Angelo police officers were dispatched at about 8:45 p.m. to 1929 Raney St. for a report of a shooting victim, according to a department statement. Learn More Here.
